notes.title: Big changes coming...
notes.notes:
ENEMIES GONE SUBURBAN was awesome while it lasted! After a month on standby getting nothing done on the development side I decided I didn't know what I wanted from the project and was happy with what I created but making another addition to the enemies franchise that hadn't exactly found the audience I wanted it to... I'm deciding to go in a different direction with this project and it will now be...



[i]Drum roll, please[/i]



[i][b]Dynamite Joe Vs The Deep Sea Invasion![/b][/i]


The core of the old game will be kept but I'm gonna change it to a linear shorter story and really focus on that quality vs quantity aspect and just try and deliver a game that's exciting, fresh, and new from what I've been doing since 2019

Think it's time to pull the plug on the ENEMIES franchise and start branching out to more solo projects and see where that takes me :-)
